messages.content: 去夏威夷旅遊的最佳月份是什麼？

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

We can provide general knowledge: best months are April to June and September to November, avoiding peak season (December-January, July-August). Also mention weather, crowds, prices. We could optionally call the function to get average temperature for a month like May or October. But the question is general. We can provide a recommendation: May, September, or October. Provide reasons: mild weather, lower crowds, good deals. Also mention that Hawaii has year-round warm weather, but the best months are late spring and early fall. Provide average temperatures. We can call get_average_monthly_temperature for Hawaii for May and October to illustrate. But the function expects location string and month string. We can pass location "Hawaii" and month "May".
